_provenance: Fictional demo data. Dealer names, fees, and finance terms are invented for the Sift 'Choose Our Next Car' hackathon scenario and do not describe any real dealer or transaction.

sharedTaxAndFeeAssumptions.salesTaxBasis: vehicle advertised price plus mandatory dealer add-ons; documentation fee is not taxable under this fixture's fictional state schedule

advertisedFinancingExample.description: Dealer website advertises 'as low as 4.9% APR for 60 months for well-qualified buyers,' shown alongside the advertised price with no mention of mandatory add-ons.

mandatoryAddOns.label: Value Protection Package (paint sealant, fabric guard, nitrogen tire fill, VIN etching)
mandatoryAddOns.note: Dealer policy: pre-installed on all lot inventory of this trim, not removable or waivable.

actualFinancingOffer.description: Credit decision actually available to this household at time of quote, disclosed only after requesting a written offer.
actualFinancingOffer.note: Longer term than the advertised financing example; the advertised 4.9%/60-month example was not available to this household given the amount financed after mandatory add-ons.

priceBreakdown.arithmeticNote: 27995.00 + 2395.00 (value protection package) + 499.00 (doc fee) = 30889.00 subtotal. Taxable base excludes the non-taxable doc fee: 27995.00 + 2395.00 = 30390.00; sales tax = 30390.00 * 0.07 = 2127.30. True out-the-door = 30889.00 + 2127.30 + 275.00 (title/registration) = 33291.30.

underAdvertisedTerms.basis: 4.9% APR, 60 months, financing 24995.00 (advertised price minus down payment, ignoring add-ons as the advertisement implies)

underActualOfferedTerms.basis: 7.49% APR, 75 months, financing 30291.30 (true out-the-door minus down payment)

estimatedMonthlyPayment.note: Standard amortization estimates, rounded to the nearest cent for illustration. The runtime ownership-cost calculator is the source of truth for any figure the product displays.
